profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: With over 15 years of experience architecting, developing, and collaborating on complex projects, I have a breadth of technical and relational experience in a wide variety of areas, including C++, C#/.NET, Python, SQL, Docker, Azure, GitHub Actions, and agile development. I excel at maintaining well-organized code via peer reviewing, providing automated CI/CD flows, enhancing contributor and end-user experiences, and communicating effectively with team members.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a Python automation platform to enhance Excel-based reporting for clients.  
• Created a data integration and reconciliation pipeline from multiple sources, including MySQL and Azure SQL databases.  
• Implemented secure cloud components for data access, ensuring compliance and safety.  
• Delivered the system as a packaged Windows application through a CI/CD pipeline, streamlining deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Microsoft Azure · Azure SQL · Azure Functions · MySQL · Git · Product Support

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
• Delivered tailored instruction to individuals and groups, enhancing comprehension of complex concepts.  
• Achieved a student pass rate that exceeded the annual GED completion goal by over 10%.  
• Maintained effective communication with leadership and colleagues, ensuring clarity and professionalism.  
• Analyzed student performance data using Microsoft Excel, enabling targeted interventions for improved outcomes.
positions.insights: Skills: Integrating Technology in the Classroom · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · Educational Technology · Adult Education · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Academic Instructor
positions.description:
• Delivered adult basic education in Spanish to incarcerated individuals, enhancing their literacy and mathematical skills.  
• Fostered communication with the Mexican Instituto Nacional para la Educación de los Adultos (INEA) to facilitate student certification.  
• Developed tailored lesson plans that improved student engagement and learning outcomes.  
• Contributed to CoreCivic's mission of rehabilitation through education, impacting the lives of underserved populations.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · Adult Education · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Science Teacher
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented engaging science lessons and lab experiments aligned with Georgia Standards of Excellence.  
• Supervised a bimonthly SAT testing program for 30 to 150 students, ensuring compliance with testing protocols.  
• Collaborated on a model team for co-teaching, providing in-classroom demonstrations to enhance teaching practices.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Developed a C# application using RS-232 serial communication to programmatically control physical A/V hardware, replacing manual IR control with software-driven device management.
- Maintained and troubleshot A/V hardware and software to ensure reliable operation during live services, resolving issues quickly to minimize disruptions.
- Installed and configured electrical and Ethernet cabling to support new A/V equipment.
- Created documentation to standardize processes for other technicians.

projects.title: Korman Blender Plugin
projects.description:
- Implemented a pipeline in Python 3  to export from Blender 3D files to a format consumable by Plasma engine, allowing content artists to freely create and modify assets.
- Guided Blender users in prioritizing requested enhancements to this export process and encouraged open feedback to ensure that results were as expected.
- Constructed a CI/CD pipeline in GitHub Actions that automatically builds and publishes new releases based on git tags to ensure ease of installation by the user base.

projects.title: Plasma Engine
projects.description:
- Delivered a turnkey build process for a large legacy codebase using CMake and vcpkg, allowing new developers to start contributing easily.
- Devised a phased work plan and prioritized backlog for multi-member team to upgrade an embedded Python 2 environment to Python 3, which better supported  4 additional localizations for dozens of non-native English speaking users.
- Replaced 3 proprietary libraries with open source equivalents and meticulously adjusted API usage to match previous behavior seamlessly.
- Ensured coding standards were met and constructively reviewed over 370 pull request contributions prior to merging.
